views.claude:
Set up nextcard

Free to use, no account needed

Choose your app

Add nextcard to Claude

nextcard is listed in the official Claude directory. Connect it once and it's available in every Claude chat.

Open in Claude (opens in a new tab)
  1. 1Open nextcard in the Claude directoryUse Open in Claude, sign in to Claude, then choose Connect to Claude. Signed out, the button reads Sign in to add.
  2. 2Sign in with nextcard (optional)You can ask without an account. To get answers about your own cards, sign in with your nextcard account and approve access.
  3. 3Turn on nextcard in your chatIn a Claude chat, open the + menu, choose Connectors, and make sure nextcard is on.

Want answers about your own cards?

You can connect and ask without an account. Sign up free and add your cards so your assistant can also answer from your Wallet.

Then ask your assistant

Pick a question to open it in Claude, ready to send.

  • “What's the cheapest hotel in Chicago across the credit card hotel programs?”
    Ask Claude
  • “Which credit card hotel program hotels in Paris are under $500 a night?”
    Ask Claude
  • “Which Hyatt hotels in Tokyo are in a credit card hotel program, and what's the lowest nightly rate at each?”
    Ask Claude
  • “Is the Ritz-Carlton in Kyoto part of Fine Hotels + Resorts or The Hotel Collection?”
    Ask Claude
  • “Show me hotels within 25 miles of Napa and which card programs each one is in.”
    Ask Claude

nextcard is listed in the official ChatGPT plugin directory. Install it once and ChatGPT can use it in any chat.

Open in ChatGPT (opens in a new tab)
  1. 1Open nextcard in ChatGPTUse Open in ChatGPT to go to the nextcard listing in the ChatGPT plugin directory. Sign in to ChatGPT if it asks.
  2. 2Install the pluginOn the nextcard listing, choose Install plugin. When ChatGPT asks, choose Connect.
  3. 3Sign in with nextcard (optional)You can ask without an account. To get answers about your own cards, sign in with your nextcard account when ChatGPT asks.
  4. 4Ask in a new chatChatGPT uses nextcard when your question needs it. To choose it yourself, type @nextcard.
